source: Zeliard (DOS) mpp*/cpat/mpat/dpat GRP headers + fight.asm/town.asm collision routines

cavern.bankHeader: First 48 bytes of the unpacked mpp*.grp (loaded at seg1:8000h). 0x00-0x17 passable list (24 bytes, zero padded), 0x18 slope "/" ids (x4), 0x1C slope "\" ids (x4), 0x20 hazard ids (aggressive_ground_list, x4), 0x24 airflow up, 0x28 airflow left, 0x2C airflow right (x4 each).

routines.name: is_blocking_tile
routines.rule: id < 0x40: blocked unless in passable list; id >= 0x40 passable. Used for walls, head room, jump start, airborne moves (callers 871, 1111, 1394, 1682-1718, 1848).

routines.name: is_blocking_tile_simple
routines.rule: id < 0x49: blocked unless in passable list (so platform tiles 0x40-0x48 are solid floor); id >= 0x49 passable. Used by check_floor_for_landing (1940-1960) and the foot-level check when walking (1130, 1413).

routines.name: is_blocking
routines.rule: Monsters: id < 0x49 list lookup; 0x49-0x7F passable; >= 0x80 blocked (entity markers in the proximity layer).

routines.name: is_blocking_tile_extended
routines.rule: Same as is_blocking_tile but threshold 0x49. Its 0x90/0x91 "cant_pass" branch is unreachable for map tiles (only reached with id < 0x49).

routines.name: is_over_rope
routines.rule: Tiles 1 and 2 are rope in every bank.

routines.name: get_slope_direction
routines.rule: Slope ids come from the bank header lists at 0x18 / 0x1C.

routines.name: step_on_aggressive_ground
routines.rule: Hazard ids from header 0x20; damage per cavern level (table at 3624): 1,1,4,8,20,20,20,20,20 for levels 1-9; Pirika shoes give immunity; checks the 3x3 hero body plus the tile under its centre.

routines.name: get_airflow_direction
routines.rule: Airflow ids from header 0x24/0x28/0x2C. Pushes the hero 2 rows (up) or 2 tiles (left/right) per frame. At cavern level 7 airflow does not block hero movement; at level 5 left/right airflow tiles block monsters (200FIGHT.asm area_num checks 1772, 7502).

routines.name: set_zero_flag_if_slippery
routines.rule: Cavern level 4: all standing ground except tiles 0x40-0x48 is ice unless Ruzeria shoes are worn.

notes: Door frames (0x49-0x60) and door signs (0x61+variant) are stamped over the base grid at load by process_doors (research/zeliard-expanded/extracted/Zeliard-master/asm/fight.asm:4144, tiles at 4294). They are passable.
Platform tiles 0x40-0x48 are NOT in the base grid; the platform tables stamp them at run time.
Breakable walls, falling blocks, chests and pickups are entities in the monster table, not tiles.
There is no water mechanic in the cavern engine.
Heat: cavern level 7 costs 15 HP every 64 frames unless the Asbestos cape is worn (tile-independent).

town.bankHeader: cpat/mpat/dpat unpacked: word +0 anim-count table, +2 special (blocked) list [count][ids], +4 replacement pairs [count]([old][new])... FFh. Pointers are relative to the file start (town.asm:2203-2208 relocates them).

routines.name: check_tile_in_special_list
routines.rule: A tile blocks the hero only if it is in the bank special list. Only row 7 (the floor row) of the column ahead is checked (left: research/zeliard-expanded/extracted/Zeliard-master/asm/town.asm:1080, right: 1132).

routines.name: find_non_passable_npc_at_x_pos
routines.rule: NPCs with n_flags bit 6 also block.
